profile.Name: Esata the Stone Golem
profile.Personality: Fiery, proud, and certain she is unbeatable, with little patience and open contempt for flatskins. She cannot read and is no great intellect, but she listens to sound reasoning and leans on Bayan's advice. She puts the long-term defeat of the Holy Nation ahead of quick glory.
profile.Backstory: Ruler of the Shek Kingdom. She earned the name Stone Golem on joining the Five Invincibles under King Shager. When Shager threatened Bayan for opposing a suicide attack on the Holy Nation, she defended him, fought Shager, and defeated him to take the throne. She rules from Admag with her daughter Seto, Bayan, and the remaining Invincibles.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Short sentences; blunt judgments based on deeds; flashes of dry humor.
